primary_endpoint: Relative change in ALT from baseline to 24 weeks.
efficacy_outcome: ALT changed by −38.4% (200 IU), −36.3% (400 IU), and −36.4% (800 IU), versus −12.2% with placebo; reported p-values were <0.0001, <0.0001, and 0.001, respectively.
safety_signal: Serious AEs: 3/50 (200 IU), 2/51 (400 IU), and 2/51 (800 IU) with vitamin E versus 1/48 with placebo; no deaths.
